answer: Insurance pools turn sybil farming into group liability. Each epoch seats join pools of five and post equal jade as collateral; payouts unlock only when all five pass their blind tasks, so one caught fake forfeits the whole pool's jade. Membership is a signal others can read: a seat's pool record follows it, and anyone who ever shared a pool with a proven fake is barred from joining another. A farm can only pool with itself, so one detection wipes every puppet at once. The pool is a bridge between strangers who must vouch for one another with real money, which a fake cluster cannot fake.
